limitations: External annotations independent of this inference, not guaranteed absent from model training
COCO negatives mean no annotated person/animal among its80classes; inspect for unannotated wildlife
Upstream sanity examples are separate from frozen holdout, not independent model development data
Still-image panel does not qualify motion between sampled frames or UK seasonal/night camera diversity
Wellington labels are sequence-level; individual selected frames require visual review before freezing. Location-disjoint development/holdout split.
curation: External annotations plus explicit pre-inference visual corrections; no outputs used to curate labels. Wellington is evaluated as complete externally labelled bursts.
